data.description: At this point we have a number of enemies, power-ups and a boss, but no game. We need to create a full playable game with levels. Create a game sart menu that allows the player to move to the gym scene index or the playable game. In the playable game we need a series of waves of increasing difficulty. The first set of waves will have a single enemy type. Then we will end the level with a boss. The next level will consist of pairs of enemies and a boss level in which the boss spawns more enemies.
data.title: Create a playable game
